著.meaning: traditional form of 着; aspect particle (-ing); marks ongoing action or state
著.sentence_pinyin: tā zhèng kàn zhe nà běn shū ne
著.sentence_english: He is looking at that book.

为.meaning: why; for; because of; as in 为什么
为.sentence_pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me xué xí zhōng wén

染.meaning: to infect; to spread; to dye or stain; as in 传染
染.sentence: 他感冒了，会传染给别人。
染.sentence_pinyin: tā gǎn mào le, huì chuán rǎn gěi bié rén
染.sentence_english: He has a cold and can spread it to other people.

微.meaning: slight; tiny; as in 微辣
微.sentence: 这道菜微辣，但是不太辣。
微.sentence_pinyin: zhè dào cài wēi là, dàn shì bù tài là
微.sentence_english: This dish is mildly spicy, but not too spicy.

挽.sentence_pinyin: tā wǎn zhe mā ma de gē bo
挽.sentence_english: She is holding her mother's arm.

算.meaning: to calculate; to reckon/figure; as in 打算: to plan or intend
算.sentence_pinyin: wǒ dǎ suàn zhōu mò zài jiā xiū xi
算.sentence_english: I plan to rest at home this weekend.

敏.meaning: quick/sharp; as in 敏感: sensitive
敏.sentence_pinyin: wǒ duì huā fěn yǒu diǎn mǐn gǎn
敏.sentence_english: I'm a bit sensitive to pollen.

戏.meaning: play/drama; as in 游戏: game
戏.sentence: 《英雄联盟》是我最喜欢的游戏。
戏.sentence_pinyin: yīng xióng lián méng shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yóu xì
戏.sentence_english: League of Legends is my favorite game.
